Draw Four Exhibition Identity
Identity, Poster, Print2023

Exhibition identity for VCUarts Qatar's 2023 Exhibition, Draw Four. The exhibition sent to Doha from Richmond features 70 drawings, textiles and sculptures from VCUarts Richmond, AFO students. The identity work included printed posters, signage, wall vinyls and labels, Instagram and web assets.
